image_description: A dramatic coastal landscape featuring steep, dark rock cliffs rising vertically from a turbulent ocean. The cliffs exhibit rugged, weathered textures with visible stratification and erosion patterns. Green vegetation covers the plateau tops and clings to ledges. A narrow path or road is carved into the side of the foreground cliff. The water is churning white against the base of the rocks.
